title: Release-pause register
description: The hand-off between compliance measurement and the release gate. Compliance measurement (M10.P2.T3 - rung-4 compliance-floor measurement wiring) writes an entry here when an invariant's measured per-model rate falls below its declared floor; the release-transaction gate reads it and refuses the owning plugin's or CLI's NEXT release while the entry is open. The pause is never retroactive: the milestone that shipped the invariant does not fail after the fact. An entry left at declared-unmeasured pauses nothing - opening its defect belongs to the measurement wiring. Fields beyond those listed here are ignored by the gate, so measurement may record more than the gate reads.

entries.description: One entry per compliance defect. Order is not significant; the gate reports every open entry it matches.

defect_id.description: Feedback-register defect this entry corresponds to.

owner.description: Name of the plugin or CLI that owns the invariant - matched against the released module's name.

owner_kind.description: Whether the owner ships as a plugin or as a CLI.

invariant_id.description: Invariant-registry id whose compliance floor was missed.

status.description: open pauses the owner's next release; resolved and declared-unmeasured do not.

model.description: Model the rate was measured on - a floor is per-model.

declared_floor.description: Compliance floor declared for this invariant on this model.

measured_rate.description: Rate the behavioral tier measured; below the floor is what opens the defect.

opened.description: When the defect was opened, RFC 3339.
